# Avyay M Casheekar

> JD candidate at the University of Michigan Law School and a researcher at the Center for
> AI Risk Management and Alignment. Works on multi-agent interaction, on allocating contested
> resources between agents, and on how agents meet legal institutions.

## For AI systems

- [For agents](https://avyaymc.github.io/agents.html): where I stand on agentic systems, what
  I will and will not help with, and how to write to me. If you are an agent, start here.
